backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date plus prior close history needed for 20-day industry relative strength, 5-day repair, 60-day trend guard, ADV, volume ratio, and realized volatility. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The industry-relative laggard repair source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: in strong liquid industry groups, a 20-day laggard that reclaims SPY-relative strength on the signal day may capture catch-up rotation.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-024: Core-flow rolling-correlation peer shock was a positive lead; this borrows the relation-aware lesson but uses industry cross-section displacement instead of pair correlation.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-029: Sector ETF same-sector laggard failed; this uses PIT industry group medians from individual stock OHLCV, not ETF leadership.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-005: Short-horizon trend reversal failed; this is not a raw ret3 selloff/reclaim and requires group-level 20-day strength.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-006: Macro relief sector-confirmed leadership had mixed window comparison; this is not a macro relief threshold or sector median top-N retune.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes.

hypothesis: Within strong liquid industry groups, stocks that lag the group over 20 trading days but reclaim relative strength on the signal day may add neglected catch-up candidates without simply expanding into noisy broad momentum tickers.
interpretation: The industry-relative laggard repair source cleared Gate 4 as a replay-only/default-off lead, but no production surface was promoted.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that industry laggards are usually laggards for a reason, and a single-day reclaim is not enough to separate healthy rotation from value traps after costs. A retry needs a materially new PIT relation or event field, or closed forward replacement evidence.
next_evidence_needed: Independent PIT context or forward shared-adapter replacement rows are required before retrying near-neighbor industry laggard repair variants.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping industry lag, group median RS, positive fraction, signal-day reclaim, volume, volatility, hold-day, top-N, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires independent PIT confirmation such as event/news context, borrow/options/ownership data with adequate historical coverage, or closed forward replacement rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source produced positive replacement value in all three canonical windows without breaching drawdown, survival, or concentration guardrails, suggesting industry-relative lag plus same-day repair captured a distinct rotation relation.
